improvements: The bot now stops setting up new doorway lures as soon as accepted retreat injuries exhaust its safety budget, rather than waiting for the next movement review.
incoming_learnings: Accepted injury must retire exhausted lure setups immediately, rather than waiting for the periodic movement review. Canceling and restarting a doorway plan must not erase the encounter’s accumulated health loss. Verified escapes remain eligible; retirement is not proof of safety or survival.

review.review: The run ended in planner exhaustion with the hero alive at full health, not an observed death. After discovering gas and escaping, the bot repeatedly returned to an approach beside a chasm that its own potion-testing rules could never accept. These reversals exhausted exploration targets; unfinished gas-room preparation then correctly prevented descent. D192–195, log lines 542–553, establish the initiating sequence; D223–226, lines 641–654, show recovery and terminal failure. Source inspection traced the mismatch to the shared flight/gas approach envelope in tools/puzzle_supplies.py. Offline reconstruction matched every original action and reason through D195. The proposed correction tightens only gas staging geometry, preserving flight handling and all testing, storage, protection, return and mandatory-pickup checks. On a copy of that validated state, preparation instead selects an existing observed route toward a compatible western bank. The new regression fails on the original helper and passes on the candidate; the full suite passes 2463 tests with four skipped. This establishes an admitted reobservation choice, not successful potion testing, reward collection or survival.
review.learnings: A protected reward route is not enough to choose a potion-testing approach. Gas staging must also match the actual test-bank terrain requirements before preferring a remembered location. Reobservation remains preparation only: fresh visibility, inventory protection, actual potion effects and pickup receipts must still be verified.

recommendations.summary: Reject structurally incompatible gas-testing approaches before they repeatedly reverse useful exploration.
